skill.displayName: 小红书评论分析与需求挖掘

llm.summary: This skill is a read-only helper for analyzing Xiaohongshu comments using a disclosed SocialDataX API key and npm CLI.

dimensions.detail: Use of SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and network data calls is expected for the SocialDataX-backed comment retrieval purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It uses node/npm and runs the published socialdatax-skills package via npx at latest, which is disclosed in metadata and examples but means users depend on the current npm package at runtime.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to comment retrieval, pagination, and analysis output; they explicitly prohibit login, posting, liking, commenting, browser-data access, or account changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, local credential stores, or mutation authority are present in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Xiaohongshu comment analysis and the instructions only fetch comments or replies for user-provided note URLs, note IDs, and comment IDs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, make sure you trust SocialDataX with API-key based access and only use it for notes or comment threads you intend to analyze; use max-items or page limits when you do not want broad comment collection.
